statement.zh: Willey 等 1965 皮博迪专著正式报告伯利兹河谷史前玛雅聚落（含巴顿拉米）。
statement.en: Willey et al. 1965 Peabody memoir formally reports prehistoric Maya settlements in the Belize Valley (including Barton Ramie).
